lessons_used: Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in redesign changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning Hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to use their original authentication method so pets are not reset.
candidates.why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, suggesting users unintentionally create duplicate accounts.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with a different method creates a new account and won't restore previous pets.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to sign-in screen to assist account persistence.

candidates.score_note: Target step has 27.1% drop-off with 8 explicit support emails, but hint changes showed minimal historical lift (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Checklist Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload screen into a checklist layout with a visual progress bar to ensure clear custom pet image submissions.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% (89s median), and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the photo upload screen using a checklist layout.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has highest drop-off (39.1%) and support reports, but adoption redesigns consistently failed (-2.5% across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Notification
candidates.change: Enable optional ready notifications and a delayed tip carousel on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s), and users report app stalls or confusion about pet appearance.

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen enhancement with tips and ready notifications.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (201s median) and app stall complaints with notifications.

candidates.title: Story Screen Full Bleed Experience
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen into a full-bleed layout with playful mascot imagery and clear introductory narrative text.
candidates.why: The initial path selection stage has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating initial hesitation or lack of context.

intro_story.text: Begin your journey with your new interactive desktop companion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Cards
candidates.change: Switch the friend selection step to a grid layout using highlighted choice card components.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest friction drop-off in the onboarding funnel, falling from 72.9% to 60.9%.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign In Centered Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a centered layout with clear button actions to prevent screen stall confusion.
candidates.why: Support tickets noted sign-in screens stalling or failing to load, causing 27.1% drop-off at this step.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet

guard.reason: Valid centered layout redesign for the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses sign-in stall issues; previous sign-in redesign measured +1.7% lift.

candidates.title: Home Intro Mascot Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a stage layout with a mascot welcome component and clear next action button.
candidates.why: The finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with 395s median time, and support receives tickets regarding pet desktop placement confusion.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Desktop

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Path Selection Card Progress Layout
candidates.change: Reformat the choose path screen to a card layout with active step counters and time estimates.
candidates.why: Path selection takes a mean of 514s; providing structured step counts helps set clear completion expectations.

guard.reason: Valid card layout reformatting for path selection with step indicators.

candidates.score_note: Choose path already has high conversion (87.2%), but path layout redesigns show strong positive historical results (+4.3%).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Seal Layout
candidates.change: Transform the adoption certificate screen to a story scroll layout featuring an official seal badge component.
candidates.why: Reinforcing emotional attachment at the adoption stage can reduce drop-off before reaching the desktop home step.

guard.reason: Valid adoption certificate layout redesign featuring an official seal badge.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but visual redesigns at adoption stage lack evidence and historically underperform.

candidates.title: Waiting Generation Progress Bar
candidates.change: Update the waiting screen to a checklist layout with an embedded progress indicator component.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high mean time (2336s) and causes user confusion regarding whether pet generation is active.

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen layout update with progress indicator.

candidates.score_note: Helps clarify long generation mean time (2336s); similar home redesigns measured +1.6% lift.
